notes.title: Thanks for playing 10.000 Pizzas Please during Automation Fest!
notes.content:
Thank you for the love during Automation Fest!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3798960/10000_Pizzas_Please/"][/dynamiclink]



We were blown away by how many of you jumped into the pizza factory, spun your conveyor belts, and unleashed absolute kitchen chaos. 🔥🍕



Your support means a lot to our team  every comment and wishlist makes a difference.



We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’ll be improving the demo for Next Fest based on your suggestions. Your chaos will be even smoother next time.



We’ve got spicy updates in the oven, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

👉 Enjoyed the demo? Hit that wishlist button and tell a friend (or five)!

Stay cheesy,

– The 10.000 Pizzas Please Team

notes.title: Fresh Update: Speed, Clarity, and Better Rails!
notes.content:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833250/10000_Pizzas_Please_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

Hey cheeselord, 

We've just rolled out a juicy new update with quality of life improvements based on your feedback. Here's what's cooking:

Speed Controls Added:

You can now play at 1x, 1.5x, or 2x speed. Get through levels faster or take your time planning the perfect slice!

Improved Task Bar:

We've polished the task bar to better show your current objectives and which pizza needs to be delivered at the end of each one.

Rail System Improvements:

Rails are now smoother and more reliable.

Edit Mode Direction Indicators:

When in edit mode, machines and rails now show their direction clearly. This makes it easier to spot misaligned rails and fix delivery issues.



Thanks to everyone who's been playing the demo and sharing feedback! Your support helps us bake a better game every day.

Stay cheesy,

The Dev Team 🍕
